entries.label: Surgical robotics · Baltimore
entries.title: A surgical robot, built around the surgeon.
entries.description: A Galen robot demonstrates instrument positioning on a training mannequin. Its technology grew out of Johns Hopkins research.
entries.alt: Galen surgical robot positioning an instrument beside a training mannequin’s nose.

entries.name: Harbor Designs & Manufacturing
entries.label: Medical-device manufacturing · Baltimore
entries.title: From an idea to a device you can hold.
entries.description: Hemafuse blood-filter components from Harbor’s manufacturing portfolio show the physical engineering behind a medical device.
entries.alt: Orange and green Hemafuse filter components arranged on a clean manufacturing surface.

entries.name: RPM Tech
entries.label: Diagnostic hardware · Forest Hill, Maryland
entries.title: Diagnostics with engineering underneath.
entries.description: RPM Tech’s Qvella medical-instrument portfolio brings together electronics, mechanical design, prototyping, and testing.
entries.alt: Qvella FAST ID diagnostic instrument with its touchscreen and sample-processing unit.

entries.name: Salynt
entries.label: Imaging AI · Baltimore
entries.title: Another way to look at brain imaging.
entries.description: Salynt’s SmartMed is a research-stage brain-imaging platform. This conceptual illustration shows how regions can be highlighted for review; it is not a patient scan or product screenshot.
entries.alt: Salynt’s conceptual brain illustration in four views with colored regions; not a patient scan.

entries.label: CT / CAT scanning · Baltimore
entries.title: A closer look inside a CT suite.
entries.description: A Philips CT scanner in a University of Maryland Medical Center imaging suite, photographed in Turner’s hospital renovation portfolio.
entries.alt: Philips CT scanner and patient table in a University of Maryland Medical Center imaging suite.

entries.name: University of Maryland Medical Center
entries.label: MRI · Baltimore
entries.title: The scanner—and the room around it.
entries.description: A Siemens MRI scanner in UMMC’s imaging environment, shown in SETTY’s engineering portfolio. Local care depends on equipment, facilities, and the teams connecting them.
entries.alt: Siemens MRI scanner, patient table, and monitoring equipment in a UMMC imaging room.
